title: ranunculus × alopecuroides
intro: Ranunculus × alopecuroides, commonly known as the meadow buttercup, is a hybrid plant species within the Ranunculus genus. This flowering plant is known for its vibrant yellow flowers and is traditionally used in herbal medicine. The health benefits of Ranunculus × alopecuroides include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties, which can aid in soothing skin irritations, wound healing, and muscle relaxation. The plant's bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant and antimicrobial activities.
